description: Welcome to Team SESHAT! Formed specifically for this 48-hour challenge, we are building a brand-new decision-support tool from scratch. We fuse ancient Egyptian wisdom with NASA data (SMAP, ECOSTRESS). Over this weekend, we will code our "GEB Map" UI and integrate our "HAPY" hardware concept. By Sunday, we aim to deliver the "PERET Cycle" AI for smart crop rotations. We are translating cosmic data into earthly survival. Watch us build a global AgriTech solution live!
